notes.title: 🎉 New Demo 2.0 Update is Live! 🎮
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! We’ve been listening closely to your feedback and are excited to drop a brand-new version of the demo with some big improvements, new content, and game adjustements!

✨ New Content

 💡 Bonus Levels Section: A brand new space for regular community level drops(stay tuned)!
 📦 To celebrate Sokoban Fest, we've added more the box pushing levels into Chapter 1!
 💬 Discord Connection: Link your account and earn in-game rewards through Discord!
 💾 Save Slots: You can now have multiple playthroughs without losing progress.


🛠️ Game Adjustments
Many of you mentioned the game was a bit too tough. So we’ve balanced things out.

 Easier levels added to smooth out the early experience.
 Tougher challenges moved to a new Bonus Content section for those craving a real challenge!


🚀 Improvements

 🖥️ Optimized Performance for smoother gameplay
 🎨 Enhanced Graphics to make the world look even better
 🛠️ Bug Fixes


🔜 Coming Soon
🎮 Controller Support for an even better play experience
🌍 localization into additional languages so more players can join the fun!


Try out the update and let us know what you think on discord:
Discord Server Welcome Back Games

Thanks everyone for your support!❤️

WARNING:
This is a new demo with new features. Since we've also introduced a new save slot system, the old save file is not compatible with this version of the sacrifice.
